question: If Ferri-chan had been a girl, what would have happened?
answer: This is just my personal position, but as an author, it’s difficult to think about ‘What if’ questions related to the basic facts of the story. As the author, the ‘best’ shape of things is for Ferris to be a boy, so “if he was a girl instead” is that sort of thing. I simply think that Crusch-sama and Ferris would probably not become master and servant in that case.
